description: This bar chart, titled "Comprehensive Evaluation Results on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," displays performance scores for four models across eight different datasets and metrics, with the y-axis labeled "Score (%)" ranging from 0 to 80 in increments of 10, and the x-axis listing the datasets: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The legend indicates four model categories: LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue), Ours (SFT baseline) (orange), Ours (DPO baseline) (green), and Ours (Iterative RLHF) (red). For each dataset, four bars are grouped side-by-side, showing the respective model scores. The LLaMA-3-8B-it model (blue) consistently achieves the highest scores, particularly on GSM-8K (approximately 80%), MMLU (approximately 65%), and ARC (approximately 60%). The "Ours (Iterative RLHF)" model (red) generally performs well, often matching or slightly exceeding the LLaMA-3-8B-it model, with its highest score on GSM-8K at approximately 80%. The "Ours (SFT baseline)" model (orange) and "Ours (DPO baseline)" model (green) show similar performance, typically ranging between 50% and 70% across most benchmarks, with the DPO baseline often slightly outperforming the SFT baseline. The lowest scores are observed on LC AlpacaEval-2, where the LLaMA-3-8B-it model scores around 25%, the SFT baseline scores around 10%, and the DPO baseline scores around 25%. The bars are not sorted, and no visual emphasis is applied to any specific bar.
